blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Mark Villar has filed a bill seeking stronger regulation of pet aftercare services to protect Filipino pet owners and ensure the proper, sanitary, and dignified handling of deceased companion animals following the discovery of dumped pet remains in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. According ot statement on Wednesday, Villar filed Senate Bill No. 2595 — or the Proper Aftercare and Memorialization of Pets’ Remains (Pamper) Act — which seeks to establish clear standards for pet crematoriums and other aftercare service providers, strengthen government oversight, and impose stiffer penalties for the unauthorized dumping, abandonment, or improper disposal of […]... Keep on reading: Mark Villar files Pamper bill to ensure dignified farewell for pets
